name: topomark
description: A zero-dependency code map for AI coding agents: progressive-disclosure docs, per-file review stamps that catch stale summaries, and fast symbol/impact/test navigation for any repo.

interface.displayName: topomark: a code map for AI coding agents
interface.shortDescription: Navigate any repo by symbol, impact and tests; keep a layered code map honest with review stamps.
interface.longDescription: Drives the zero-dependency `topomark` CLI: outline a file's symbols, print one symbol, find definitions and references, summarise the impact of a change, select the tests it needs, and build a ranked repo map in a token budget. Keeps a progressive-disclosure code map (an L0 index, one file per area, then the code) in sync with per-unit review stamps that fail `topomark check` when an interface changes without its summary being reviewed. Bundles one skill, `topomark`.
defaultPrompt: Orient me in this repo using its code map.
Outline src/app/server.py and show me only the start method.
What breaks if I change the Router class? Which tests should I run?
Set up a topomark code map for this repo; show me the dry run first.
